name: SonicBoom Server
description: Speak chat and events through a local or remote SonicBoom TTS server. The plugin owns its backend policy and isolated UI; the host enforces capabilities and ownership.
longDescription:
Speak chat and events through a local or remote SonicBoom TTS server over plain HTTP. The plugin backend owns TTS policy and the isolated UI; the host interprets HTTP actions and enforces capabilities.

- Voices and audio outputs load live from the server
- API tokens are required when server authentication is enabled, including loopback
- Track server playback and skip, pause, resume or clear the queue

description.default: Send text to the SonicBoom server for speech synthesis.

hint.default: Spoken text. Event placeholders render before sending.
Voices load live from the server. Empty keeps the server default.
Remove this prefix (for example a chat command like !voice) from the start of the text before speaking. Placeholders render first.

description.default: Switch the audio output device used by the SonicBoom server for playback.

hint.default: Outputs load live from the server. System Default always plays through the server's default device.

description.default: Skip current audio on the SonicBoom server.
Pause audio on the SonicBoom server.
Resume audio on the SonicBoom server.
Stop and clear audio queue on the SonicBoom server.
Read a sanitized snapshot of the server audio queue.

serverUrl.description: Base URL of the SonicBoom server.

apiToken.title: API token
apiToken.description: API token from the SonicBoom admin panel (Tokens page), sent as a Bearer credential. This is not the admin password. Required when the server runs with SONICBOOM_AUTH_REQUIRED=true (the default), even on this machine. Use Get API token below to mint one with your admin login instead of copying it by hand.
